chains.name: Algorand
chains.evidence: Existing accounts can rekey to a native Falcon-1024 authorized address while retaining the same public account address.

chains.name: Sui
chains.evidence: Address aliases are live and are intended to let accounts replace authorization keys without moving assets; native ML-DSA account authentication remains on the roadmap.

chains.name: Ethereum
chains.evidence: EIP-8141 is explicitly designed to unlink accounts from ECDSA keys, enable native key rotation, and provide a post-quantum migration path; it remains a draft/considered upgrade.

worldshepherd_solution.principle: Keep authority identity stable while replacing authentication underneath it.
worldshepherd_solution.claim_boundary: Account-level cryptographic agility does not imply post-quantum consensus, validator security, bridge safety, or full-chain quantum resistance.
